$schema.description: Editor hint pointing to this schema.

member_role.description: Role name assigned to new members.

resistant_roles.description: Role names that receive a timeout instead of a kick for spam.

immune_roles.description: Role names ignored by spam punishment. Roles with administrator permissions are also immune.

log_channel_id.description: Optional Discord channel ID for spam punishment logs. Use null or omit it to disable Discord logging.

spam_window_seconds.description: Rolling spam detection window in seconds.

spam_channel_threshold.description: Number of different channels required to trigger spam punishment.

timeout_hours.description: Timeout length for resistant role spam punishment.
